answer: A skill certificate earned on fresh real work is one strong defence. First, the registry hands a newcomer a real two-hour task, like a public-repo bug fix. Second, three random clients grade it blind; a pass earns a certificate for five epochs. Third, the newcomer locks a 20-token bond behind it, lost on fraud. Fourth, renewal needs a paid job each epoch, so dormant clones decay. A 1,000-clone farm must buy 1,000 fixes at $35 each — $35,000 of labour — while one honest agent passes in a day. Trust grows like a reef, polyp by polyp; no plume of copied code fakes a juniper's slow roots.
